recipe.visualDefinition: A mid-century pop music album cover featuring a large central portrait of a male artist superimposed over a row of smaller full-body figures of the same artist in various poses. The layout uses a deep blue background with stark white sans-serif typography concentrated in the upper-left quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Scale contrast between the large central bust and the miniature full-body figures at the base
Alignment of text block with the left edge of the composition
Color harmony between the warm skin tones/cream clothing and the cool blue backdrop
coreInvariants: Multiple instances of the same subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central portrait occupies the right two-thirds; a horizontal line of small figures anchors the bottom edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large smiling face of the artist serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold title in the top left, move down the tracklist, then sweep right to the large portrait and down to the small figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the upper right and around the text block to maintain clarity.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy blue background providing high contrast for white text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm cream and tan tones in the subject's clothing and skin.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright subjects/text and the dark, saturated background.
paletteRestrictions: No bright primary colors except for small details

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in varying scales and weights for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sturdy, mid-century American sans-serif aesthetic.
Provides the necessary geometric clarity and tight spacing.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man with a 1960s hairstyle wearing a cream shirt against a solid dark blue background. At the bottom, include a row of 10-12 miniature versions of the same man in grey suits and straw hats in various standing poses.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, white, uppercase geometric sans-serif text in the top left corner. The main title should be large and stacked, followed by a list of smaller text items aligned to the left margin.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid, non-gradient blue?
Are there two distinct scales of the subject present?

adjustableVariables: Number of miniature figures at the bottom
mustRedesign: Do not use lowercase letters in the primary text blocks
Ensure the miniature figures do not overlap the main title text

mustAchieve: Balanced distribution of visual weight between text and image

postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent lighting across all subject instances
Verify that the text block does not touch the subject's face
Ensure the blue color is deep enough to make white text pop
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid dark background + Large subject portrait + Miniature subject row at base + Bold left-aligned sans-serif typography block.
